properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 11:14PM MDT until August 13 at 2:15AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Morgan County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 215 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 1114 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 1.5 inches of rain have
fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Fort Morgan and Log Lane Village.
